description: This Java source file defines the EditNoteActivity class for the Android client of Nextcloud Notes. It manages the activity lifecycle, fragment transactions for editing or viewing notes, user preferences, and interactions with account management and branding utilities.

classes.name: EditNoteActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for editing, viewing, and managing notes within the Nextcloud Notes app. Handles lifecycle events, fragment management, user preferences, account interactions, and branding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up preferences, fragment, and UI components.

methods.name: setImeInsets
methods.description: Configures window insets to handle keyboard and navigation bar padding.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents to update the displayed note or view.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Clears the keep-screen-on flag when activity stops.

methods.name: getNoteId
methods.description: Retrieves the note ID from the intent extras.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID, either from intent extras or current account.

methods.name: launchNoteFragment
methods.description: Determines and launches the appropriate note fragment based on intent data.

methods.name: launchExistingNote
methods.description: Launches a fragment for an existing note with optional mode and state discard.

methods.name: replaceFragment
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment in the container.

methods.name: getPreferenceMode
methods.description: Determines the preferred mode for note editing/viewing based on user preferences and account capabilities.

methods.name: getNoteFragment
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment instance based on mode and note ID.

methods.name: getNewNoteFragment
methods.description: Creates a new fragment instance for a new note, considering user preferences.

methods.name: launchNewNote
methods.description: Creates and launches a new note fragment, possibly prefilled with shared content or category.

methods.name: launchReadonlyNote
methods.description: Creates and launches a fragment to view a note in read-only mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Saves the last mode preference, closes the current note, and navigates back to main activity if needed.

methods.name: onNoteUpdated
methods.description: Updates UI elements when a note is modified.

methods.name: changeMode
methods.description: Switches between edit, preview, and direct edit modes for the note.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the activity UI.
